name: Database Entries Form 7
author: Centous Solutions

sections.description:
Databse Entries Form 7 automatically saves form submissions from Contact Form 7 into the database upon submission. This plugin allows you to view, search, filter, and manage all entries in an organized manner.

Supported Contact Forms

  • Contact Form 7

Plugin Features

  • View all Contact Form 7 entries in the default WordPress table format.
  • Search form entries by keyword across all columns.
  • Filter form entries by specific Contact Form 7 forms.
  • Admin can mark entries as read or unread, and move them between the read/unread sections.
  • Admin can move entries to the trash and restore them as needed.
  • Admin can view and edit individual entries.
  • To disable the collection of users’ IP addresses and browser user agents, simply toggle the corresponding settings.

Why We Built This Plugin

Contact Form 7 is a popular free contact form builder, and the Database Entries Form 7 plugin enhances its functionality by adding comprehensive entries management. You can easily manage form submissions.

GDPR Compliance

  • Disable storing user’s IP address, browser, screen resolution, and OS.
sections.faq:
How can I view all Contact Form 7 entries in WordPress?

You can view all your Contact Form 7 entries directly in the WordPress admin dashboard. The entries are displayed in a table format similar to other WordPress content lists, making it easy to manage and navigate through the data.

Can I search form entries by specific keywords?

Yes, you can search form entries using keywords. The search function scans across all columns in the entries, allowing you to quickly find the information you’re looking for.

Is it possible to filter form entries by a specific Contact Form 7 form?

Absolutely! You can easily filter form entries by selecting the specific Contact Form 7 form you want to view. This helps you manage entries for multiple forms more effectively.

How can I mark form entries as read or unread?

To mark entries as read or unread, you can either click the read/unread icon next to each entry or use bulk actions to move multiple entries to the read or unread section at once.

Can I move form entries to the trash or restore them later?

Yes, as an admin, you can move form entries to the trash. If needed, you can also restore them back from the trash, ensuring no data is permanently lost unless you choose to delete it permanently.

Is it possible to view and edit form entries?

Yes, admins can view the full details of each form entry and make edits if needed. Simply click on the “View/Edit” button next to the entry in the table.

Can I disable the collection of users’ IP addresses and browser user agents?

Yes, you can disable the collection of users’ IP addresses and browser user agents. To do this, go to the plugin settings and toggle off the corresponding options.
